evidence: ZrO and HfO films, were deposited on p-Si (100) substrates by atomic layer deposition (ALD) using an F-120 reactor (ASM-Microchemistry) using ZrCl4 and HfCl4 as sources of Zr and Hf, respectively and H2O as oxygen source. Prior to deposition, the wafers were cleaned using SC2 (HCl:H2O2:H2O 1:1:5 80 8C 10 min) cleaning.
